command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; Set-Location -LiteralPath $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE; $targets=[ordered]@{'test-494-dcoir-production-acceptance'='f8cccf7ad5bfa51110695e4065c820634384a271';'test-only-dcoir-review-suggestion-probe'='63e9985171b949732db2ff063ad06258dbd76919';'test-only-dcoir-review-verifier-probe'='f59f8da397276718b64cc9fa034b2a4228cc86da'}; $deleted=@(); $alreadyAbsent=@(); foreach($name in $targets.Keys){$line=(& git ls-remote origin "refs/heads/$name" | Select-Object -First 1); if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$line)){$alreadyAbsent+=$name; continue}; $sha=(([string]$line -split '\s+')[0]).Trim(); if($sha -ne [string]$targets[$name]){throw "Branch head moved: $name expected=$($targets[$name]) actual=$sha"}; & git push origin --delete $name; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "Failed to delete branch $name (git exit $LASTEXITCODE)"}; $post=(& git ls-remote origin "refs/heads/$name" | Select-Object -First 1); if(-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$post)){throw "Branch still exists after deletion: $name"}; $deleted+=$name}; $preserved=@('main','issue-497-preserve-candidate-identity','benchmark-478-architecture-b-replay-base','benchmark-478-architecture-b-replay-head'); foreach($name in $preserved){$line=(& git ls-remote origin "refs/heads/$name" | Select-Object -First 1); if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$line)){throw "Expected preserved branch missing after cleanup: $name"}}; $receipt=[ordered]@{schema='dcoir.branch_cleanup_receipt.v1';deleted=$deleted;already_absent=$alreadyAbsent;preserved=$preserved}; $json=$receipt | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5; $json | Out-File -LiteralPath (Join-Path $env:DCOIR_DOWNLOADS_DIR 'unused-branch-cleanup-receipt.json') -Encoding utf8; Write-Host $json
